future_consumers: reference only; no newcontrol count unless independently newexperiment
precision: Decimal50 ROUND_HALF_EVEN from raw decimal text
exit: none; no fictitious terminal fee or liquidation

statistics.base_series: 731 raw daily-close equity values including cash days, with initial100000 prepended only for returns/drawdown
statistics.sharpe_zero_cash: mean(r)/sample_std(r,ddof=1)*sqrt(365); null when standard deviation is0
statistics.monthly_return: month final equity/prior month final equity-1; firstdenominator100000; all24calendar months continuous, no reset
statistics.monthly_counts: fills by execution UTC month; days_long=endclose quantity>0; allzero activity months retained
statistics.roundtrip: a buy followed by a sell; netpnl=sale cash_after-entry cash_before; open trade excluded from win_rate
statistics.win_rate: strictly positive netpnl/closedroundtrips; zero included denominator; null if no closedtrade
statistics.exposure: endclose bars quantity>0 divided by731; no intrabar inference
statistics.fee_total: sum exact Decimal fees; represented decimaltext
statistics.floats: Decimal values converted to float64 for numpy metrics only; no float in indicators, order eligibility, allocation, valuation
statistics.serialization: CSV UTF8 csv.writer default CRLF; booleans0/1; missing empty; Decimal str no quantization; JSON indent2 UTF8 ensure_ascii=False allow_nan=False newline; no timestamps in deterministic results
